title: How to build a virtual agent your customers will want to use: 4 use cases that drive resolution, not friction
summary: A practical guide to building a virtual agent that delivers real results. Four real-world examples that show what to do right, and what to avoid.
body_markdown: On the operational side, Zoom customer[CareTalk Health](https://www.zoom.com/en/customer-stories/caretalk-health/) tripled the number of patients it supports after deploying Zoom Contact Center, with Zoom Virtual Agent (ZVA) extending that scale into after-hours scheduling so no patient inquiry goes unanswered.
